premises.text: Neurostimulation can be made accessible without requiring surgery via non-invasive tDCS
premises.evidence_span: can we make neurostimulation more accessible? Can we do this in a way that didn't require surgery? And it turns out that you can

premises.text: Priming the motor cortex increases plasticity so athletes get more strength and skill from the same training
premises.evidence_span: what happens if you prime this part of the brain so that it can be more plastic? Can you get more out of your training neurologically if you do this first? And it turns out that you can

premises.text: Halo Sport is worn like headphones with proprietary primer electrodes, paired to a phone app that turns on neurostimulation during workouts
premises.evidence_span: you would just put on Halo Sport, like a regular set of headphones, You would turn it on and pair it with an app on your phone. The app merely just turns on the neurostimulator. And you would get at it. You would pair this neuropriming technology with your workout

premises.text: Proprietary elements including 27 patents filed make the technology defensible
premises.evidence_span: multiple proprietary elements, so we have a defensible technology, 27 patents filed

premises.text: Revenue from selling headsets, semi-disposable primers and ear pads, with free app and future premium features
premises.evidence_span: Halo is a hardware company and we plan on selling headsets, semi-disposable primers, semi-disposable ear pads. Our app for now is free, but you can imagine that we'll build in premium features that we could charge money for

value.text: Greater athletic training gains in strength and skill via neuropriming
value.evidence_span: the Halo group achieved about 12% gains in leg strength versus a control group that did the exact same training program

secondary_value.text: Potential medical help for stroke-related motor disability
secondary_value.evidence_span: Half the people who have had a stroke, suffer from some sort of motor disability, and we can help these people with neurostimulation

causal_links.evidence_span: pair this neuropriming technology with your workout

notes: Patents kept with proprietary product mechanism (§4.1.1) — borderline but speaker ties patents to defensible tech of same headset. Credentials and partner logos excluded as traction. Medical use as secondary_value.
